_comment: Deferred generation (B1): two callers at distinct sites hand a shared lazy helper callbacks whose service values arrive late, declared in two orders, with a widening limit of 2 so the helper's parameters widen. Generating the statements as they are reached changes the order values arrive in; deferred_generation_matches_eager compares activation, per-site flows, escapes, key bails, widening and removals with eager generation.
